column1: Jackson Chourio leads the slate with a strong hit probability and a reliable record of reaching safely in nearly three-quarters of his games, benefitting from the leadoff spot and a favorable platoon matchup against Cade Povich. Jake McCarthy offers similar upside atop the Colorado lineup, with a steady track record and a significant park boost at home. Yandy Diaz and Junior Caminero also profile as consistent options in Tampa Bay’s order, each drawing a platoon edge and solid recent form.
